decisions.reason: The source adds fixture dimension annotations but does not change the floor-plan concept, format, or required layout content.
The request to show shower, sink, and door dimensions does not change the separate furnished drawing or the furnishings it must show.
Adding dimension annotations does not alter the established fixture locations or plumbing constraints for the Unit 1 common bathroom.
The source requests display of fixture dimensions and does not change any Unit 3 bathroom placement, partition, clearance, or drainage rule.
The annotation request does not modify the en-suite configuration or its fixture and door locations.
Showing shower, sink, and door dimensions does not change Unit 2 bathroom placement, partitioning, toilet constraints, or door position.
The contextual reference to door dimensions does not change the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The source does not change retention or shared use of the existing main steel door.
The fixture-annotation request does not modify the Unit 3 counter arrangement or its bathroom-door clearance constraint.
The source has no effect on whether the balcony remains open or is incorporated into the adjacent room.
Adding fixture dimensions to the plan does not alter corridor width, wall shifts, entrance-area allocation, or the unresolved layout alternatives.
The source changes drawing annotations only and does not alter any wall-preservation, demolition, or construction instruction.
